parent_objective: audit whether current-model local relocation and short-sequence lattice source construction is exhausted
blocked_by: M1247 produced fine relocation candidates and near-boundary viable rows, but still produced zero accepted capability-separable rows
supersedes: another immediate local relocation grid expansion
training before an accepted source corpus exists

public_gates: M1248 must preserve actor input contract
M1248 must not use private holdout
M1248 must classify the negative source-construction evidence before proposing the next source variable
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters, relocation labels, or oracle outcomes to actor inputs
do not claim self-identification from source-construction negatives
do not start another relocation-grid run before the audit decision

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies the M1242-M1247 source-construction negatives and decides whether to continue local relocation or pivot source variable
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process/source-limit audit only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop local relocation branch if the audit finds near-boundary viable rows remain action-equivalent and action-divergent rows remain nonviable
stop if the next proposal would only expand the same public grid without a new evidence variable
fallback_plan: if current-model local relocation is exhausted, pivot to a new source variable such as richer sequence candidates, learned/teacher proposals, event timing, or higher-fidelity dynamics
if a narrow implementation bug explains the negative result, pre-register one focused repair smoke
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1247 completes the second local relocation repair with zero accepted source-positive rows

admission_evidence: M1242 one-step lattice, M1244 short-sequence lattice, M1246 coarse viability-band relocation, and M1247 fine relocation all produced zero accepted separable pairs
M1247 produced one near-boundary viable selected pair but it was action-equivalent
M1247 retained a two-sided regret row but it remained nonviable
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: audit classifies the negative source shape
audit names the next source variable or closes the branch

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1248 audits source-construction negatives and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until source-positive cases exist
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Record the zero-accepted-row result as source evidence, not as evidence against the overall driver objective.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: M1242-M1247 indicate a current-model local-relocation source-shape limit rather than a reason to train on the current zero-accepted corpus.
success_criteria: audit cites M1242, M1244, M1246, and M1247 evidence
audit decides whether local relocation continues or pivots
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit ignores M1247 fine relocation evidence
audit proposes training on zero accepted source rows
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1248 passes if it records the negative source evidence, prevents training on zero accepted rows, and chooses the next source variable or branch closure without actor-input expansion.
